chapters.summary: Council staff announce the webinar has started, welcome attendees to the Committee on Land Use vote, and instruct devices to be silenced and no one to approach the dais. The chair is then invited to begin.
chapters.title: Council staff opens webinar and sets Land Use Committee rules

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: The webinar has started.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the New York City Council vote for the Committee on Land Use.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: At this time, please put all devices on silent.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: And going forward, no one is to approach the dais.

utterances.speaker: Council Staff
utterances.text: Chair, you may begin.

chapters.summary: Council Member Kevin Riley opens the meeting as Chair and introduces himself. He welcomes colleagues including Chair Lewis, Council Members Osei, Zhuang, Justin Sanchez, Thomas-Henry, Minority Leader Carr, and Majority Leader Abreu.
chapters.title: Chair Riley opens meeting and welcomes Land Use Committee members

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Good afternoon and welcome to a meeting on the Committee on Land Use.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I'm Councilmember Kevin Riley, Chair of this committee.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I want to welcome my esteemed colleagues joining me today, including Chair Lewis, Councilmember Osei, Councilmember Zhuang, Councilmember Justin Sanchez, Councilmember Thomas Henry, and Minority Leader David Carr.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We've just also been joined by Majority Leader Sean Abreu.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley states the committee will vote on four items and thanks Chair Lewis, Zonin, Chair Marte, and Landmarks for subcommittee leadership. He then previews the approvals and modifications to be considered.
chapters.title: Chair Riley announces four Land Use items and thanks subcommittee chairs

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Today we are voting on four items and I want to thank Chair Lewis and Zonin and Chair Marte and Landmarks for their ongoing leadership in our subcommittees.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley explains LUs 148 and 149, the 108-05 68th Road rezoning in Council Member Shulman's Queens district. The project would create about 33 apartments, eight permanently affordable through MIH, and the modification removes MIH option 2 and adds option 3.
chapters.title: Chair Riley describes 108-05 68th Road rezoning and MIH modification

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We will vote to approve with modifications LUs 148 and 149 related to the 108-05 68th Road Rezoning Proposal in Councilmember Shulman's District in Queens.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: For a zoning map and zoning text amendment to facilitate the development of a mixed-use residential project, including approximately 33 apartments, of which eight units would be permanently affordable with MIH.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Our modification will be to remove MIH option 2 and to add option 3.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley moves to LUs 150 and 151, the 100-12 Queens Boulevard rezoning also in Council Member Shulman's district. The mixed-use project would include about 389 apartments, up to 97 permanently affordable through MIH, with the same modification to remove MIH option 2 and add option 3.
chapters.title: Chair Riley describes 100-12 Queens Boulevard rezoning and MIH modification

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We will vote to approve.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: with modifications, LUs 150 and 151, related to the 100-12 Queens Boulevard rezoning proposal, also in Councilmember Shulman's district in Queens.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: For a zoning map and zoning text amendment to facilitate the development of a mixed-use residential project, including approximately

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: 389 apartments, of which up to 97 units will be permanently affordable through MIH.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Our modification will be to remove MIH option 2 and to add option 3.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley describes LU 152, the South Richmond Designated Open Space Text Amendment in Council Member Marano's Staten Island district. It would make targeted corrective changes to designated open space boundaries affecting three sites, consistent with a 2023 text amendment within the Special South Richmond Development District.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines South Richmond designated open space amendment

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We will also vote to approve LU 152 related to the South Richmond Designated Open Space Text Amendment and Councilmember Marano's District in Staten Island,

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: which would incorporate targeted corrective changes to designated open space boundaries affecting three sites

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: in a manner consistent with the purpose and intent of a 2023 text amendment that streamlined the way certain designated open spaces were defined and protected.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Within the special South Richmond Development District.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley describes LUs 153 and 154, the Studio 54 Rehabilitation Text Amendment and Special Permit in Council Member Wilson's Manhattan district. The zoning text amendment and special permit would facilitate rehabilitation of the Studio 54 Theater in the Special Midtown theater subdistrict in exchange for bonus floor area transferable to eligible sites.
chapters.title: Chair Riley outlines Studio 54 rehabilitation text amendment and special permit

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: And we will also vote to approve LUs 153 and 154 related to the Studio 54

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Rehabilitation Tax Amendment and Special Permit in Councilmember Wilson's District in Manhattan for a zoning tax amendment and a zoning special permit to facilitate the rehabilitation of Studio 54 Theater in the theater sub-

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: district of the special midtown district in exchange for a generation of bonus floor area to the applicant that could be transferred to eligible sites elsewhere within the theater sub-district.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley calls for a vote to approve LU 152, LUs 153 and 154, and to approve with modifications LUs 148 and 149 and LUs 150 and 151. He asks the clerk to call the roll on the coupled items.
chapters.title: Chair Riley moves approval of all Land Use items and calls roll call

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I will now call for a vote with the support of local members to approve L.U.'s 152 for the South Richmond Designated Open Space Text Amendment,

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: L.U.'s 153 and 154 for the Studio 54 Rehabilitation Text Amendment and Special Permit.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: To approve and to approve with modifications, LUs 148 and 149

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: for the 108-05 68th Road Rezoning and LUs 150 and 151 for the 100-12 Queens Boulevard Rezoning.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Will the clerk please call the roll?

chapters.summary: Committee Clerk William Martin conducts the roll call, noting all items are coupled. Chair Riley and several members vote aye, with the clerk recording the responses before announcing the tally.

chapters.summary: Clerk Martin announces a vote of 9 in the affirmative, 0 in the negative, and no abstentions. All items are adopted as described by the chair.
chapters.title: Committee adopts all Land Use items 9-0

utterances.speaker: William Martin
utterances.text: With a vote of 9 in the affirmative, 0 in the negative, no abstentions.

utterances.speaker: William Martin
utterances.text: All items have been adopted as described by the chair.

chapters.summary: Chair Riley asks for the record to note that Council Member Banks joined the meeting. He thanks the public, colleagues, council staff, and Sergeant of Arms, then adjourns the meeting.
chapters.title: Chair Riley notes Council Member Banks joined, thanks participants, and adjourns

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I just want to stay for a record.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: We've been joined by Councilmember Banks.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: That concludes today's business.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: I would like to thank the members of the public, my colleagues, council staff, and the Sergeant of Arms for participating in today's meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: This meeting is hereby adjourned.

utterances.speaker: Kevin C. Riley
utterances.text: Thank you.

summary: Committee on Land Use convened for a vote on four land use items: 108-05 68th Road and 100-12 Queens Boulevard rezonings, South Richmond open space amendment, and Studio 54 rehabilitation.
Chair Riley described modifications to remove MIH option 2 and add option 3 for the two Queens rezonings, and outlined approvals for South Richmond and Studio 54.
The committee adopted all items as coupled by a 9-0 roll call and adjourned.
title: Committee on Land Use
